assessments.intent_alignment: Nested task TDD/review requirements remain intact. The amendment adds selectable Grill decisions with same-response optional text and distinguishes authorized missing gates from explicit plan stops.
assessments.scope_and_retries: Existing task ownership, bounded retries, evidence checks, and integration gates remain unchanged.
assessments.test_classification: RF-005..007 retain public integration obligations. RF-001..004 and RF-008..009 are semantic review criteria with independent authorizations.
assessments.bundles: BUNDLE-03 covers projection of Grill and continuation contracts; RF-03 owns generated delivery and parity.
assessments.interaction: Native choice controls are used only when callable in the current mode and question type and able to preserve a selected option plus added text. A mutually exclusive Other is insufficient; fallback accepts a numbered choice plus text in one reply.
assessments.continuation: An authorized next action blocked by stale or missing confirmation is asked with a choice control. An explicit plan stop is reported as complete within scope.
